title: Affinity-selected peptide ligands specifically bind i-motif DNA and modulate c-Myc gene expression
authors: Guneri D; Rosonovski S; Alexandrou E; Chen S; King J; Waudby CA; Haider S; Morris CJ; Waller ZAE
one_liner_zh: 该文通过噬菌体展示筛选结合c-Myc启动子i-motif DNA的肽配体并调控基因表达，属蛋白质-DNA互作但非TF-DNA体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，仅实验筛选。
abstract:
c-Myc is an oncogene that is dysregulated in ~70% of cancers. Its multifaceted function complicates effective drug targeting of the protein. i-Motif DNA structures in gene promotor regions have gained attention for their potential role in modulation of gene expression. These include the i-motif formed by the cytosine-rich sequence that lies upstream of the key P1 promotor of the c-Myc gene. Currently, selective ligands interacting with i-motif structures are limited. Here, peptide ligands for the i-motif from the promoter of c-Myc were identified via phage display. Hit peptides were filtered for selective binding to i-motif structures over other DNA structures using displacement assays and DNA melting experiments. Two lead peptides were found to produce dose-dependent changes on c-Myc gene expression after delivery into HEK293 cells expressing a c-Myc luciferase reporter construct. These leads may be used as chemical tools for the manipulation of c-Myc i-motif in vitro and have potential to be developed into cell-permeable peptidomimetics for delivery in vivo .

c-Myc是一种致癌基因，在约70%的癌症中发生失调。其多功能特性使得针对该蛋白的有效药物靶向变得复杂。基因启动子区域中的i-Motif DNA结构因其在基因表达调控中的潜在作用而受到关注。这些结构包括由位于c-Myc基因关键P1启动子上游的胞嘧啶富集序列形成的i-motif。目前，与i-motif结构选择性相互作用的配体有限。在此，通过噬菌体展示技术鉴定了针对c-Myc启动子i-motif的肽配体。使用置换实验和DNA熔解实验，筛选出对i-motif结构具有选择性结合而非其他DNA结构的命中肽。发现两条先导肽在递送至表达c-Myc荧光素酶报告构建体的HEK293细胞后，对c-Myc基因表达产生剂量依赖性变化。这些先导肽可作为体外操作c-Myc i-motif的化学工具，并具有开发为细胞渗透性拟肽以用于体内递送的潜力。
